episodes.instruction: Hold the button down with the mallet head until it changes color, then promptly release it. Use only the mallet head to press the button, keeping its contact center within 1.5 cm of the button center throughout the hold. Maintain continuous pressure until the color cue, then allow the button to return fully within 1 second. Once a valid hold begins, releasing before the cue fails the trial. After release, keep the button untouched and fully released for 0.5 seconds. Do not press again after a successful release.
